title: Drifting Secret Tracking via Cross-Packet CNOT Velocity Locking and R_Z Counter-Rotation
claims: Under linear secret drift s^{(t)} = (s_0 + t * delta) mod q, static time-averaging over a drift period T = q / gcd(a*delta, q) dephases identically to 0.0 for all s_0.

Adjacent-packet cross-CNOT gates on the b=1 difference branch isolate the time-invariant velocity phase 2*pi*a*delta/q, and adaptive R_Z(-2*pi*a*t*delta/q) counter-rotation restores 100% coherent alignment with s_0.
favorable_controls: Unit drift delta=1 mod 8 (s_0=0, static avg 0.0 vs tracked +0.9)
Even drift delta=2 mod 16 (s_0=8, static avg 0.0 vs tracked -0.9)
